# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Entirely invented learning-garden trials reporting learner recall

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture

## Query log
- 2026-10-08: supplied fixture `fixture-001.json` (invented-index), 2 hits. No live backend searches run because the records are entirely invented.

## Screening

- ivory: included
